description: Structure ratchets checked by archlint CAP012/CAP013 (tools/archlint/structure.py). Rules state what the architecture promises; counts and ceilings only fall. Raise a line ceiling only with `archlint structure --raise AREA --reason ...`. Audit: RFC/direction-audit-2026-10-08.md.

rules.reason: composition selects and wires providers; graph passes, resources and commands belong to their pass modules (RFC 0016 anti-corruption boundary, 2026-10-08)
passes and the scene consume material programs and parameter blocks; parsing legacy material definitions belongs to render.material's importers and the legacy frontend
the game's world, props and models reach passes as render.scene instances seen through views (RFC 0016 K5/K6); this is the side channel that bypasses the scene
Tier 0 answers through the foundation providers (R103); a platform branch belongs in a provider, and only frozen ABI declarations may still need one
PS3 and Xbox 360 are not declared profiles; their code and shims are dead
portable code requests behavior, not OS identity; a platform branch belongs in a provider
an OS, SDK or graphics API header outside a provider; inject a contract instead
a direct OS, SDL or platform SDK call outside a provider; call a platform contract
a runtime test of the platform or backend identity outside a provider; ask the capability, not the platform
graphics API types, calls or backend classes outside a device adapter or bridge; use render.device.v2 or a presentation contract

vphysics/.reason: the IVP provider reads the collision format it simulates (PHY, vcollide text) until RFC 0004 F's independent collision decoder owns it

rules.reason: a content format header outside its format library or a translator; take the runtime representation a translator or the resolver hands you

vphysics/.reason: the IVP provider reads the collision format it simulates (PHY, vcollide text) until RFC 0004 F's independent collision decoder owns it

rules.reason: a content format's on-disk structure (studio, BSP, VTF, PHY layouts) outside its format library or a translator; use the runtime model (for example a model's skeleton and sequences, not mstudio* records)

lines.baseline: 2026-10-08: every ceiling set to the area's size at the direction audit (RFC/direction-audit-2026-10-08.md); later raises record their reason under "raised".

outside-providers.reason: Platform and adapter code lives only in providers and pair-specific bridges (AGENTS.md architecture; RFC 0001 'No platform or adapter code outside providers', user direction 2026-10-08). The engine, games and every other product module request behavior through contracts. Tier 0 is listed while R103 moves its branches into providers; it has its own ratchet (tier0-platform-branches).

outside-format-owners.reason: Content formats and their data shapes are known only to format libraries and translators (RFC 0027 libraries, RFC 0016 anti-corruption boundary; user direction 2026-10-08: engine and games do not know content formats or shapes unless they absolutely need to and it makes sense, which a rule records under `declared` with its reason and row). Tools, compilers and the editor's domain know formats by purpose and are outside this scope.
